hypothesis: The existing all-rating-category LightGBM may add complementary nonlinear interactions to the already-submitted targeted-category blend, without new parameter search.
decision_rule: One frozen candidate only. Compare with the current 50/50 blend on the same primary and confirmation rows. Require positive AUC difference in both, and a positive lower conditional paired 95% bound on confirmation, before considering full refit. No public-score weight tuning. Otherwise retain the submitted best and record negative/inconclusive results.
new_training_limit: At most one 415-tree CPU confirmation fit; full fit only if the predeclared comparison passes and time permits all verification and Library delivery before deadline.
